title: Feed Seedance 2.5 the audio track as input to generate a music video synced to…
content:
Feed Seedance 2.5 the audio track as input to generate a music video synced to the music.  
Provide character reference(s) and location reference(s) alongside the music to better control subject consistency and scene setting.
